lines.label: Request
lines.text: An oil change and a tire rotation, nothing else today.

lines.label: Limit
lines.text: Please don't go over $250 without calling me first.

lines.label: Extras
lines.text: Text me the price in writing before you start.

caption: Three sentences to say before the keys change hands. The amounts are examples.

items: Ask the seller for receipts and shop names
Write down the odometer and date
Check the VIN for open recalls
